otherFacts.value: 1941 Fred and Helmy Beckey, upper west ridge; 5 pitches WI2 M5 in winter

notes: Two starts in use. Summer: Depot Creek Road via Chilliwack Lake (BC), per earlier stephabegg page and search summaries (Mountain Project camp at head of Depot Creek); not reopened this pass.
